# Event Loop

## Message processing
- One loop pass awaits a message, then drains everything already queued (including messages the handlers just queued), and draws one frame. A burst of auto-repeat keys costs one frame, not one per key.
- `QuitMsg` ends the loop directly. `BatchMsg` / `SequenceMsg` are unpacked in place.
- [`TryHandleLoopMsg()`](mex://method:10950c203f2b3917a135d4031842de88) swallows the loop's internal aggregate messages (`BatchDispatchMsg`, `RateLimitDispatchMsg`) before they reach the model — they are `internal`, never seen by app code.
- [`ProcessMsg()`](mex://method:2e0835d0178650bcfa4189be760c1b22), in order: applies `ThemeChangedMsg` to the runtime theme (then still passes it to the model), runs click hit-testing for a left-press `MouseMsg`, calls `model.Update`, dispatches the cmd, reconciles subscriptions, and marks the renderer dirty **only if the returned model is a different reference** (or the msg is `RedrawMsg`). Returning `this` from `Update` means "nothing to draw". `WindowResizeMsg` invalidates the previous buffer and renders immediately.

## Commands
- `ICmd` is `Func<Task<IMsg>>`. [`App.DispatchCmd()`](mex://method:082d941a1878f171462ea5c9c68bb7d0) invokes it; if the task already completed (`Cmd.Msg`, `Cmd.Quit`) the result is written straight to the channel so it lands before the next render tick — otherwise it is awaited off the loop. A throw becomes `CmdErrorMsg(ex)`.
- `Cmd.Debounce(key, interval, fn)` / `Cmd.Throttle(...)` return a `RateLimitDispatchMsg`; the window is held by the running `App` keyed by the string key, so a cmd rebuilt fresh in every `Update` still coalesces. Time comes from the loop's clock — tests inject it (`Microsoft.Extensions.TimeProvider.Testing`) instead of sleeping.

## Subscriptions
- [`ReconcileSubscriptions()`](mex://method:9ee9e9fb62cb655e8c714374069d078d) diffs `IHasSubscriptions.Subscriptions()` by key after every `Update`: removed keys are cancelled, new keys start an `IAsyncEnumerable<IMsg>` pump; existing keys are left running. Errors surface as `CmdErrorMsg(ex, "sub:<key>")`.
- Only the **root** model is consulted. A sub-page or component cannot declare subscriptions (WISHLIST item 1).

## Focus
- The model owns focus. Widgets carry an app-assigned `FocusKey` and an `init`-only `HasFocus` that the model's `View()` sets. `FocusManager.CollectFocusKeys` / `GetNext` / `GetPrev` are pure helpers for Tab cycling.
- [`HandleMouseFocus()`](mex://method:2b219049aa77cebe9da3add5d564f259) hit-tests a left click against the last rendered `(root, layout)` under `_renderLock` and posts `FocusRequestedMsg(key)` if a widget with a `FocusKey` was hit. The model decides what that means.

## Components
- `IComponent` / `IComponent<TResult>` are sub-programs stored as fields of the parent model. [`Component.Delegate()`](mex://method:b102df705a04b71338883edd1376280f) forwards a message to a (nullable) child and returns `(next, cmd)`; the parent stores `next` with `with` and returns `cmd`. `IsCompleted()` / `Result` signal a returning component.
